From 789d54a4178634850e441f60c0326124138e7269 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Quinn Tran <qutran@marvell.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jun 2022 21:46:25 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] scsi: qla2xxx: edif: Fix n2n discovery issue with secure
 target

User failed to see disk via n2n topology. Driver used up all login retries
before authentication application started. When authentication application
started, driver did not have enough login retries to connect securely. On
app_start, driver will reset the login retry attempt count.

Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220607044627.19563-10-njavali@marvell.com
Fixes: 4de067e5df12 ("scsi: qla2xxx: edif: Add N2N support for EDIF")
Signed-off-by: Quinn Tran <qutran@marvell.com>
Signed-off-by: Nilesh Javali <njavali@marvell.com>
Signed-off-by: Martin K. Petersen <martin.petersen@oracle.com>

diff --git a/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_edif.c b/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_edif.c
index 3ece46ae9d6b..d31dd942bfb0 100644
--- a/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_edif.c
+++ b/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_edif.c
@@ -515,6 +515,9 @@ qla_edif_app_start(scsi_qla_host_t *vha, struct bsg_job *bsg_job)
 	}
 
 	if (N2N_TOPO(vha->hw)) {
+		list_for_each_entry_safe(fcport, tf, &vha->vp_fcports, list)
+			fcport->n2n_link_reset_cnt = 0;
+
 		if (vha->hw->flags.n2n_fw_acc_sec)
 			set_bit(N2N_LINK_RESET, &vha->dpc_flags);
 		else
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_edif.c`**
- Added a loop that resets the `n2n_link_reset_cnt` for each `fcport` in the `vp_fcports` list to zero. This is done at the beginning of the `qla_edif_app_start` function when the N2N topology is detected.

### Relationships
The modification addresses a bug related to the N2N discovery issue with secure targets. The driver previously exhausted all login retries before the authentication application could start, leading to a failure in establishing a secure connection. By resetting the `n2n_link_reset_cnt` at the start of the application, the driver ensures that it has sufficient login retries available for secure connections, thereby fixing the issue. This change is directly related to the previously introduced N2N support for EDIF, as indicated by the "Fixes" tag in the patch.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
fcport->login_retry = vha->hw->login_retry_count;
```
```c
if (N2N_TOPO(vha->hw)) {
```
```c
if (fcport->scan_state != QLA_FCPORT_FOUND)
```
Reason:
The driver was exhausting all login retries before the authentication application started because the `login_retry` count was not reset when the application began. This led to a failure in establishing a secure connection, as the driver did not have enough retries left to connect securely when the authentication application was finally initiated.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
list_for_each_entry_safe(fcport, tf, &vha->vp_fcports, list)
    fcport->n2n_link_reset_cnt = 0;
```
```c
fcport->login_retry = vha->hw->login_retry_count;
```
Reason:
The patch resets the `n2n_link_reset_cnt` to zero when the application starts, ensuring that the login retry count is appropriately managed. This allows the driver to have sufficient login retries available for establishing a secure connection after the authentication application starts, thus resolving the discovery issue in the N2N topology.
